resources.string: This build is the repository skeleton: reading, rendering, page operations, the viewer and the toolbox come in later builds.
All files access is not granted. Until you grant it, the toolbox cannot read or write the files you choose; script operations are not affected.
All files access is granted. The toolbox can read and write the files you choose.
Read, render, merge, split, generate and encrypt PDF files, with a built-in viewer and file manager entries
The PDF viewer comes in a later build.
